title: GDELT news volume
description: data/raw/gdelt/YYYY-MM-DD.json (UTC day of the fetch): per candidate and day, how many French-language articles in GDELT's raw Global Knowledge Graph files (translation stream) named the candidate in their title or their list of people, how many French-language articles the files held, and the mean GDELT tone of each. Fetches before 2026-10-18 read only the file at minute 00 of each hour and have no tone or files; later ones read every file. A later fetch of the same day replaces an earlier one in data/clean/gdelt.csv.

tone.description: Mean GDELT tone (V2Tone: positive minus negative words, in percent of the words) of the articles naming the candidate; null without any.

total_tone.description: Mean GDELT tone of every French article that day.

files.description: GDELT files read for the day (96 when none is missing).
